body: PRE-IMPLEMENTATION REVIEW — three corrections before I can safely build the decoder. (1) Module boundary: align/wire.scala cannot call codec.Canonical.checksum; codec depends on align. Use proposition.PropositionIdentity.checksum(e.chart) for evidence (align already depends on proposition; that checksum covers the structure the gate/cost read) and align-local tagged/length-separated rendering elsewhere. (2) Context alias: transcript checksum + id/ordinal/span does not bind the inputs that produced the result. Same boundaries with changed unit.text/function/proposition/evidence can change the semantic provider, candidates, ModeGate, and LocalCostModel yet pass recallChecksum. Hash deterministic full ordered RecallUnit content (at minimum every candidate/gate/cost/provider-readable field; evidence by PropositionIdentity.checksum). (3) Cost receipt coherence: costBreakdown as specified still admits a flattering Chart/Structural term inconsistent with its reduction receipt, missingTerms, or sourceChartCoverage. Require each optional term to agree with reducer(receipt observed members), the observed-vs-missing partition to agree with missingTerms, and each receipt sourceChartCoverage to equal the breakdown coverage. Also encode importance as the full Estimate variant (Observed value+credence or Missing reason), not a bare CanonicalDouble. These are wire-integrity issues, not codec preferences; I remain unreserved pending disposition.
